snippet.title: Neoteria Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Neoteria is a classic horizontal shoot em up game (shmup) for Android and iOS. 

Get the game now!

iOS : http://itunes.apple.com/app/neoteria/id503652796
Android: https://market.android.com/search?q=neoteria&c=apps



Hidden worlds, different difficulty modes (un-lockable pilots)  AWESOME sound track and great retro graphics and sound effects.

Game starts in easy mode, but Hard mode is as challenging as all our games are, getting the full 100% completion is not for the weak or casual gamer!

More information about the game can be found: http://orangepixel.net/neoteria
